title: Prime-sum growth and elliptic-curve rank
exact_target: Is the rank of an elliptic curve the coefficient of double-logarithmic growth of this prime sum?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8900014 (AMR-088-0014). CC BY 4.0.
Christian Wuthrich, \emph{Open problems in number theory}, lecture slides (December 2011) final slides headed Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture: $f(X)$ grows like $r\log(\log X)$.
